title: Pasted text looks messy? Paste it clean in 1 second ✨ #Shorts
description:
Copied text from a website and it came with weird fonts, colors and highlights? One shortcut pastes it as plain, clean text.

⌨️ Windows: Ctrl + Shift + V
🍎 Mac: Cmd + Shift + Option + V (Cmd + Shift + V in many browsers)

Note: in Microsoft Word use Ctrl + Alt + V or the Paste Options menu instead.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
